hook: Indiramma family insurance launches *Nov 19* in Siddipet
hook_b: Indiramma family insurance launches *Nov 19* in Siddipet
tldr: CM Revanth Reddy will launch the scheme at a Siddipet public meeting on Indira Gandhi's birth anniversary.

beats.what: Light green Indiramma sarees for women will also start being distributed at the event.
beats.why: The govt is holding public meetings in constituencies held by senior BRS leaders.
beats.care: Families should watch for eligibility and enrolment details once the scheme launches.
